correctness.rationale: The minimum-length lemma uses the k occurrences of each of three letters and the k-rich-block/arch equivalence. Fixed phase has 6^k independent permutation blocks. Pair phase intersections force a fixed symbol at one position in each block, giving 3*2^k; triple intersection forces period three, giving six. Inclusion-exclusion gives L_k and exact phase layers. For Burnside, nonmultiple-of-three rotations cannot fix a valid word because rotating phases forces all three and hence exact period three. Multiple-of-three rotations fix L_gcd(k,j) words; divisor grouping gives N_k. Period divisibility and Möbius inversion give primitive counts. Every step and k=1 boundary have been checked. Exhaustive independent word and necklace enumeration through k=4 matches all formulas, with explicit subsequence-pattern checks through k=3; no computational extrapolation is used for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Circular scattered-factor universality is a motivated reconstruction/coverage invariant. At the sharp lower length 3k the linear case has merely (3!)^k labeled words, but rotation-phase overlaps make the cyclic count and primitive orbit structure nontrivial. This gives a natural complete classification for all ternary sizes k, including exact labeled, necklace, primitive-necklace, and phase-multiplicity spectra and exponential asymptotics. The precise numbers distinguish rotational cover redundancy; they are not arbitrary finite parameter slices.
